title: rcf-schemas 0.9.0 consumer side B: retired criteria in coverage, EVAL coverage and deterministic verify
summary: rcf-lite carries the rcf-schemas 0.9.0 retired-criterion rule (US-19401): retired criteria in rcf audit coverage, rcf audit eval coverage and deterministic verify. Delivers AC-19401-5 to AC-19401-12.
approach: In src/query/coverage.js a criterion carrying supersededBy gets per-AC state retired with supersededBy, leaves the requirement decision in both modes, keeps any bound TC listed and uncounted; the successor-missing, self-supersession and cycle checks print a supersession line and fail strict mode with exit 4 (src/cli/coverage.js, the table, json and mermaid formatters); src/query/eval-coverage.js gives outcome retired; deterministic verify resolves a retired criterion as retired without a request.
deliverables: src/query/coverage.js, src/cli/coverage.js, src/query/formatters/: retired state, supersession findings
notes: Order in the train: after FBS-227 (dependsOnFbsIds FBS-227, buildOrder 231). Its retired-rule fixtures carry supersededBy, which validates only under rcf-schemas 0.9.0, so it builds on FBS-227's pin bump. Split from the original FBS-227 by ledger 52 into three chained specs. Tests: this spec's share of TS-260 is TC-260-retired-state-with-successor, TC-260-successor-missing, TC-260-self-supersession, TC-260-supersession-cycle, TC-260-retired-tc-listed-not-counted, TC-260-live-gap-beside-retired and TC-260-eval-coverage-retired, declared in test/cli/coverage-retired.test.js, and TC-260-verify-skips-retired-probe (AC-19401-12), whose declaration stays in test/verify/probe-assertion-0-9-0.test.js so its bound testPointer does not move; the test-author turns each into a red test at this FBS's own Define fill round. Commits carry Hand: trailers. No freeze, no ack verbs.
